senses.definition_en: fear, hatred of, hostility or discrimination against Madrid, Madrilenian people or culture

examples.ref: 2021 March 9, Europa Press, “Ayuso denuncia que se ha promovido una "madrileñofobia nunca vista hasta ahora" durante la crisis del coronavirus”, in 20 Minutos:

examples.english: Madrilenianophobia is a profitable discourse in those regions that, instead of looking outwards to compete and grow, compare themselves only to Madrid.
examples.ref: 2021 August 9, Jorge Vilches, “Los orígenes provincianos de la madrileñofobia”, in El Español:
examples.text: La madrileñofobia es un discurso rentable en aquellas regiones que, en vez de mirar hacia fuera para competir y crecer, se miden sólo con Madrid.
examples.translation: Madrilenianophobia is a profitable discourse in those regions that, instead of looking outwards to compete and grow, compare themselves only to Madrid.

examples.english: The spokesperson of the PSOE in the Assembly of Madrid, Hana Jalloul, has accused this Saturday the Popular Party and specifically the president of the Community of Madrid, Isabel Díaz Ayuso, of exercising "Madrilenianophobia" with its "disaster" in the management of the second doses of the vaccine in the region.
examples.ref: 2021 August 7, “El PSOE acusa de "madrileñofobia" al PP y a Ayuso”, in El Periódico de Aragón:
examples.text: La portavoz del PSOE en la Asamblea de Madrid, Hana Jalloul, ha acusado este sábado al Partido Popular y en concreto a la presidenta de la Comunidad de Madrid, Isabel Díaz Ayuso, de ejercer la "madrileñofobia" con su "desastre" en la gestión de las segundas dosis de la vacuna en la región.
examples.translation: The spokesperson of the PSOE in the Assembly of Madrid, Hana Jalloul, has accused this Saturday the Popular Party and specifically the president of the Community of Madrid, Isabel Díaz Ayuso, of exercising "Madrilenianophobia" with its "disaster" in the management of the second doses of the vaccine in the region.

glosses: fear, hatred of, hostility or discrimination against Madrid, Madrilenian people or culture

examples.english: The feminist collective has an information table where they can sell products derived from marijuana as part of the "economic protest", but the consumption of weed is no longer allowed at the location.
examples.ref: 2025 November 4, Fabián Evaristo, “Avanza orden en puntos 420 de la CDMX; aún se vende cannabis”, in El Universal:
examples.text: El colectivo feminista mantiene una mesa de información donde pueden vender productos derivados de la marihuana como parte de la “protesta económica”, pero ya no se permite el consumo de yerba en el lugar.
examples.translation: The feminist collective has an information table where they can sell products derived from marijuana as part of the "economic protest", but the consumption of weed is no longer allowed at the location.
